"import csv

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

CSV_PATH = "perf_04.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.pptx"

COLUMNS = ["config", "cl_max", "cd_cruise", "ld_ratio"]


def norm_header(h):
    return h.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- read data
with open(CSV_PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    raw_rows = [row for row in reader if row and any(c.strip() for c in row)]

header = [norm_header(h) for h in raw_rows[0]]
data_rows = [[c.strip() for c in row] for row in raw_rows[1:]]

col_idx = {name: header.index(name) for name in COLUMNS}

records = [{name: row[col_idx[name]] for name in COLUMNS} for row in data_rows]

# ------------------------------------------------------- compute statistics
cl_max_vals = [float(r["cl_max"]) for r in records]
cd_vals = [float(r["cd_cruise"]) for r in records]
ld_vals = [float(r["ld_ratio"]) for r in records]

n = len(records)
clmax_max = max(cl_max_vals)
cd_mean = sum(cd_vals) / n
ld_mean = sum(ld_vals) / n
best_idx = max(range(n), key=lambda i: ld_vals[i])
best_config = records[best_idx]["config"]

clmax_max_s = f"{clmax_max:.3f}"   # e.g. 0.613
cd_mean_s = f"{cd_mean:.4f}"       # e.g. 0.0333
ld_mean_s = f"{ld_mean:.1f}"       # e.g. 17.1

print(f"records={n} clmax_max={clmax_max_s} cd_mean={cd_mean_s} "
      f"ld_mean={ld_mean_s} best={best_config}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- build deck
prs = Presentation()
title_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]      # Title slide
content_layout = prs.slide_layouts[5]    # Title only

# Slide 1 — Title
s1 = prs.slides.add_slide(title_layout)
s1.shapes.title.text = "Engineering Test Briefing"
s1.placeholders[1].text = "Aerodynamic Performance Data Review"

# Slide 2 — Data table
s2 = prs.slides.add_slide(content_layout)
s2.shapes.title.text = "Data"

n_table_rows = n + 1
tbl_shape = s2.shapes.add_table(
    n_table_rows, len(COLUMNS),
    Inches(0.7), Inches(1.4), Inches(8.6), Inches(0.32 * n_table_rows),
)
table = tbl_shape.table

for j, name in enumerate(COLUMNS):
    cell = table.cell(0, j)
    cell.text = name
    for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
        for run in p.runs:
            run.font.size = Pt(14)
            run.font.bold = True

for i, rec in enumerate(records, start=1):
    for j, name in enumerate(COLUMNS):
        cell = table.cell(i, j)
        cell.text = rec[name]
        for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            for run in p.runs:
                run.font.size = Pt(14)

# Slide 3 — Summary (numbers computed from the CSV)
s3 = prs.slides.add_slide(content_layout)
s3.shapes.title.text = "Summary"

summary_lines = [
    f"CLmax max = {clmax_max_s}",
    f"CDcruise mean = {cd_mean_s}",
    f"L/D mean = {ld_mean_s}",
    f"best config (max L/D) = {best_config}",
]

tb = s3.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(1.6), Inches(8.4), Inches(4.0))
tf = tb.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True
for k, line in enumerate(summary_lines):
    p = tf.paragraphs[0] if k == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "• " + line
    p.font.size = Pt(22)
    p.space_after = Pt(10)

# Slide 4 — Next steps
s4 = prs.slides.add_slide(content_layout)
s4.shapes.title.text = "Next steps"

next_steps = [
    "Review the best configuration identified in the summary",
    "Collect additional repeat runs to confirm the observed trends",
    "Circulate this briefing to the engineering team for comment",
]

tb4 = s4.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(1.6), Inches(8.4), Inches(4.0))
tf4 = tb4.text_frame
tf4.word_wrap = True
for k, line in enumerate(next_steps):
    p = tf4.paragraphs[0] if k == 0 else tf4.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "• " + line
    p.font.size = Pt(22)
    p.space_after = Pt(10)

prs.save(OUT_PATH)
print(f"Saved {OUT_PATH} ({len(prs.slides)} slides)")"
